---
title: "Blog Posts"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

Posts written for the World Bank's blogs, most recent first.

```{r}
blogs <- read_csv("data/wb_blogs_auto.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(date))

# Keep every fragment on one newline-joined line with no blank lines: a blank
# line makes pandoc split the raw HTML into separate paragraphs and emit stray
# empty <p> elements (same gotcha handled in portfolio.qmd).
blogs %>%
  mutate(
    date_str = format(date, "%B %Y"),
    title_html = ifelse(
      is.na(url),
      glue("<strong>{title}</strong>"),
      glue("<a href='{url}'><strong>{title}</strong></a>")
    ),
    desc_html = ifelse(is.na(description), "", glue("<span class='blog-desc'>{description}</span>"))
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<div class='blog-entry'>",
    "{title_html}",
    "<span class='blog-date'>{date_str}</span>",
    "{desc_html}",
    "</div>",
    .sep = ""
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  {glue("<div class='blog-list'>\n{.}\n</div>")} %>%
  cat()
```
